title: SAP Basis Administrator
summary: An SAP Basis administrator keeps a company's SAP systems (the business software that runs finance, sales and supply chain) installed, patched, fast and safe to change. They sit in the IT infrastructure or SAP technology team, often at an IT services company, and work with the database, server and functional SAP teams.
dailyDuties: Import transport requests between development, quality and production systems
Check system health, background jobs, dumps and HANA backups
Apply kernel patches and support packages in planned downtime
Run client copies and system refreshes for test teams
Work incidents and change requests within agreed SLAs
Plan upgrades and S/4HANA conversions with the project team

skills.expectation: Run SAP systems day to day: transports, client copies, kernel patches and system refreshes
Administer HANA databases: backups, memory, log volumes and system replication
Plan and run upgrades and ECC to S/4HANA conversions with SUM/DMO
Administer the server that runs SAP, usually Linux and sometimes Windows
Administer the server that runs SAP, usually Linux and sometimes Windows
Set up backups, high availability and disaster recovery for SAP landscapes
Work incidents and change requests under ITIL processes and SLAs
Explain outages and planned downtime clearly to functional teams and clients
Support older SAP systems that still run on Oracle
Automate routine checks with shell scripts
Run SAP on AWS or under RISE with SAP

groups.label: A server operating system (Linux or Windows Server)

certifications.why: Useful where SAP runs on AWS
Useful where SAP runs on Azure
